algorithm.orders: Pure buy-floor/sell-ceil limit-price arithmetic only; event-specific order lifecycle not simulated.
algorithm.rebase: q_new=q*r; entry_new=mark_old/r; realized=q*(mark_old-entry_old); balance_new=balance+realized; no fractional quantity rounding.
algorithm.reference: USD shareholder price and distribution components remain separate from USDT target price; no reference substitution.
